message.content:
Below is a quick reference for the **long‑weekend holidays in Canada for 2023** (i.e., holidays that fall on a Monday, Friday, or are observed on a Monday/Friday so that you get a three‑day break).  
Note that some holidays are provincial, so the long‑weekend effect may vary by province. The list below reflects the most common federal or widely‑observed holidays that create a long weekend across the country.

| Holiday | Date (2023) | Day of Week | Long‑Weekend Effect |
|---------|-------------|-------------|---------------------|
| **Family Day** (Alberta, BC, Saskatchewan, Ontario) | Feb 20 | Monday | ✔️ (Mon 20 + Sat‑Sun 18‑19) |
| **Good Friday** | Apr 7 | Friday | ✔️ (Fri 7 + Sat‑Sun 8‑9) |
| **Victoria Day** | May 22 | Monday | ✔️ (Mon 22 + Sat‑Sun 20‑21) |
| **Canada Day** | Jul 1 | Saturday | ✔️ (Sat 1 + Sun 2) |
| **Labour Day** | Sep 4 | Monday | ✔️ (Mon 4 + Sat‑Sun 2‑3) |
| **Thanksgiving** | Oct 9 | Monday | ✔️ (Mon 9 + Sat‑Sun 7‑8) |
| **Remembrance Day** | Nov 11 | Friday | ✔️ (Fri 11 + Sat‑Sun 12‑13) |
| **Christmas** | Dec 25 | Monday | ✔️ (Mon 25 + Sat‑Sun 23‑24) |

### Quick Notes

- **New Year’s Day** (Jan 1) fell on a Sunday in 2023, so the weekend was already a long weekend (Jan 1‑2).  
- **Boxing Day** (Dec 26) fell on a Tuesday; it does not create a long weekend unless a bridging day is observed in a particular province.  
- Some provinces observe additional holidays (e.g., **St. Patrick’s Day** in Newfoundland & Labrador, **St. John’s Day** in Manitoba, **St. George’s Day** in Prince Edward Island) that can also create long weekends if they fall on a Monday or Friday.

Feel free to copy this table into your holiday‑planning app or use it as a reference for scheduling long‑weekend getaways in Canada for 2023.
